Classic spreads evenly. Supersaw uses a centre voice plus detuned sides. Octaves, Power and Minor stack intervals. JP Super follows the measured JP-8000 curves: narrow detune until near the top, Blend trades the centre against the sides, and a high-pass at the note removes low rumble. Best with 7 voices.
Centre voice against side voices.
Stereo spread of the unison voices.

Analog life for this oscillator. Each voice and unison voice gets a tiny fixed pitch offset plus a slow drift, like a real analog poly; filter cutoff and envelope times of the voice get a small spread too (the highest Analog of the playing oscillators sets that part). Chords and unison breathe and sound wider and warmer. At 100%: about 5 cents fixed, 3 cents drift, 3% cutoff, 5% envelope times. 0% is exact and digital.
